panels.title: The model in the shadow
panels.about: A local model replayed against the requirement author's real inputs, judged by the same mechanical gate as the sonnet rows that shipped. Nothing here touches a run.

panels.title: Shadow model against sonnet
panels.about: Gate-pass rate of the local model's requirement rows against the sonnet rows that shipped, judged by the same mechanical gate, once per run. The gap between the lines is the distance to handing the pipeline's biggest bill to a model that costs nothing.
queries: SELECT at AS time, 'local: ' || (payload->>'model') AS metric, jnum(payload->'local_rate') AS value FROM events WHERE kind='learning' AND (payload->>'item')='shadow_eval' UNION ALL SELECT at, 'sonnet', jnum(payload->'sonnet_rate') FROM events WHERE kind='learning' AND (payload->>'item')='shadow_eval' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Shadow evals
panels.about: Every shadow eval there has been, newest first: which model, on how many requirement pairs, and how the two scored.
queries: SELECT at, (payload->>'model') AS model, jnum(payload->'pairs') AS pairs, round(jnum(payload->'sonnet_rate'), 0) AS sonnet_pct, round(jnum(payload->'local_rate'), 0) AS local_pct, round(jnum(payload->'sonnet_rate')-jnum(payload->'local_rate'), 0) AS gap FROM events WHERE kind='learning' AND (payload->>'item')='shadow_eval' ORDER BY at DESC

panels.title: What every run leaves for it
panels.about: The raw material a tune is made of, hoarded at publish into the learning store.

panels.title: Hoard shipped per run
panels.about: What each run's transcripts, requirement pairs and suite verdicts weighed once tarred and shipped to the learning store. A run that shipped nothing left nothing to tune on.
queries: SELECT at AS time, 'shipped' AS metric, jnum(payload->'kb')/1024.0 AS value, (payload->>'ticket') AS label FROM events WHERE kind='learning' AND (payload->>'item')='hoard' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Hoard contents per run
panels.about: Inside each shipment: how many session transcripts and how many requirement-author files. The files are the pairs a tune is made of.
queries: SELECT at AS time, 'transcripts' AS metric, jnum(payload->'transcripts') AS value, (payload->>'ticket') AS label FROM events WHERE kind='learning' AND (payload->>'item')='hoard' UNION ALL SELECT at, 'funcreq files', jnum(payload->'funcreq'), (payload->>'ticket') FROM events WHERE kind='learning' AND (payload->>'item')='hoard' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tuning
panels.about: Every fine-tune there has been. Reported by the tuning step as one learning event with item 'tune': base, model, samples, epochs, loss, minutes. No tuning step exists yet; the chart is the contract it will be held to.

panels.title: Tunes
panels.about: One row per tune: what it was made from and what it came to.
queries: SELECT at, (payload->>'base') AS base, (payload->>'model') AS model, jnum(payload->'samples') AS samples, jnum(payload->'epochs') AS epochs, jnum(payload->'loss') AS loss, jnum(payload->'minutes') AS minutes FROM events WHERE kind='learning' AND (payload->>'item')='tune' ORDER BY at DESC

panels.title: Loss per tune
panels.about: Final training loss of each tune, over time. Read beside the shadow eval that follows it: a loss that falls while the gate-pass rate does not is a tune that learned the wrong thing.
queries: SELECT at AS time, (payload->>'model') AS metric, jnum(payload->'loss') AS value FROM events WHERE kind='learning' AND (payload->>'item')='tune' ORDER BY 1
